issues.description: The full test suite fails to compile. 11 test files in test/errors/ directory fail with 'Required named parameter voiceApi must be provided' when instantiating StudyTutorApp. Affected files: test/errors/transport_error_test.dart (line 155), test/errors/session_ended_test.dart (line 17), test/errors/unauthenticated_test.dart (lines 15, 51), test/errors/session_forbidden_test.dart (line 19), test/errors/session_not_found_test.dart (line 17), and 6 more. Runtime parity check failed with exit code 1 (expected 0).
issues.suggestion: Update all test files in test/errors/ directory to include the voiceApi parameter when instantiating StudyTutorApp. Create a mock VoiceApi instance in each test file and pass it to StudyTutorApp constructor: StudyTutorApp(identity: identity, sessionApi: sessionApi, voiceApi: mockVoiceApi). Verify the full test suite compiles and runs with: cd app && flutter test

issues.description: Adding a required parameter to a widely-used widget (StudyTutorApp) requires updating ALL instantiation sites, not just the files you directly modified. The compilation failure affects at minimum 11 test files across the errors/ directory.
issues.suggestion: Before submitting, always run the full test suite (flutter test) to ensure no compilation or runtime regressions. Use IDE refactoring tools or global search to find all instantiation sites when adding required parameters.

rationale: The runtime_parity check is authoritative evidence that the full test suite does not compile. The Player added voiceApi as a required parameter to StudyTutorApp but failed to update at least 11 test files in the test/errors/ directory. Exit code 1 with stderr showing 'Required named parameter voiceApi must be provided' across multiple files is a critical regression. AC-009 requires zero errors from project-configured checks - a non-compiling test suite violates this. AC-008 requires no regression to typed tutoring, which cannot be verified when existing tests don't compile. All acceptance criteria are rejected because the codebase is in a broken state that prevents independent verification.
